title: Juventus's Champions League scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League goals for Juventus since 1992/93.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Nicola Amoruso: Nicola Amoruso is just outside with 9.
notes.Arturo Vidal: Arturo Vidal is just outside with 9.
notes.Dusan Vlahovic: Dusan Vlahovic is just outside with 9.

checks: Each player total is the sum of his goals for the club in every season, from UEFA.com season stats and from Transfermarkt season scorer lists; the two agree on every figure shown unless the value gives both. UEFA.com files a mid-season mover's whole season under his later club, so those seasons were split using Transfermarkt game logs. Del Piero: Transfermarkt and Wikipedia 42, UEFA.com 41.
